FN-6YNW9Z3-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 321
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 321 as introduced would lower the minimum balance that must be maintained in the
Alabama Dry-cleaning Environmental Response Trust Fund from $1 million, under current law,
to $250,000 beginning in Fiscal Year 2026.
The approximate balance of this fund is $1.19 million, as of April 2025.
